What is the equation of the circle given above?
worked_solution:
The general equation of a circle with radius $r$ centered at the point $(a,b)$ is 

$$
(x-a)^{2}+(y-b)^{2}={r}^{2}.
$$

From the picture, we see that our circle is centered at $C(-5,0)$ and the radius of the circle is $r=7.$ Therefore, the equation of the circle is

$$
\begin{aligned}(x-a)^{2}+(y-b)^{2} & ={r}^{2} \\ {(x-(-5))}^{2}+(y-0)^{2} & ={7}^{2} \\ (x+5)^{2}+{y}^{2} & =49.\end{aligned}
$$
